title: Yeasty Peruvian Sweetened Condensed Milk Pudding
description: A springy, romantic Peruvian dessert featuring sweetened condensed milk and miso-marinate. This dish is suitable for Buddhist temple-friendly gatherings.

ingredients.name: Miso Paste
ingredients.notes: white miso for a lighter flavor, red miso for a stronger umami taste

ingredients.name: Active Dry Yeast
ingredients.notes: rapid rise yeast may produce a lighter, airier pudding

ingredients.name: Granulated Sugar
ingredients.notes: adjust to taste, but traditional Peruvian desserts rely on the natural sweetness of condensed milk

ingredients.name: Unsalted Butter
ingredients.notes: softened for a lighter, fluffier texture

ingredients.name: Large Eggs
ingredients.notes: room temperature for best mixing results

ingredients.name: Vanilla Extract
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality, pure vanilla extract for the best flavor

instructions: Combine sweetened condensed milk, miso paste, yeast, sugar, and softened butter in a large mixing bowl.
